feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 4:45pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Gradually turning cloudy this evening with the wind slowly backing northeast and starting increase. Rain will arrive around midnight, this becoming persistent and quite heavy with a risk of localised flooding where drains are blocked.

Heavy rain will continue at first tomorrow, with a continued risk of localised flooding, before gradually clearing to sunny intervals in the afternoon. Strong northwest winds, touching gale force in exposed spots for a time, the maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

An very unsettled weekend, with heavy rain on Saturday morning with gale force southerly winds and some coastal overtopping.

The wind will turn southwest early afternoon, with occasional showers, then wind then increasing to SEVERE Gale on Saturday evening and overnight into Sunday with gusts up to 70 mph.

Travel disruption and some damage is likely.

The winds will gradually ease later on Sunday.


##Sunrise##

8:01am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

6:03pm Tomorrow
